question: Chip, Condor, Duff and Driver are some of the terms used in ________.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Golf**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Golf** is a sport where players use various clubs to hit balls into a series of holes on a course in the fewest number of strokes.
 
• The terms mentioned in the question—**Chip, Condor, Duff, and Driver**—are commonly used in the game of Golf and relate to specific actions or equipment in the sport.
 
• A **Chip** refers to a short-distance shot played from around the green, usually intended to land the ball softly and roll toward the hole.
 
• A **Condor** is an extremely rare scoring achievement in golf, representing a hole-in-one on a par-5 hole.
 
• A **Duff** is a poorly executed shot in golf, where the ball is mishit, often leading to very little progress or distance.
 
• A **Driver** is a type of golf club primarily used for long-distance shots, often off the tee at the beginning of a hole.
 
• **Golf courses** are designed with varied terrains, including greens, fairways, bunkers, and hazards, making strategy and skill essential.
 
• The sport is played globally and has prestigious tournaments such as the **Masters, U.S. Open, The Open Championship,** and **PGA Championship.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Horse Polo**__

 __
 
• **Horse Polo** is a team sport played on horseback, where players use mallets to hit a small ball into the opposing team's goal.
 
• The game originated in ancient Persia and is now played worldwide, with notable tournaments like the **Argentine Open Polo Championship.**
 
• chukker, ride-off, handicap, and mallet.
 
 
 
• **Chess**__
 __
 
• **Chess** is a strategic board game played between two players, involving a checkered board and pieces such as the king, queen, bishops, knights, rooks, and pawns.
 
• Key terms in chess include **checkmate, stalemate, castling, and en passant.**
 
• The game is played globally, with the **World Chess Championship** being the most prestigious event.
 
 
 
• **Swimming**__
 
 
• **Swimming** is an individual or team water-based sport where players race using various strokes such as **freestyle, backstroke, breaststroke, and butterfly.**
 
• It is an Olympic sport, and events are held in **pools or open water.**
 
• Terms related to swimming include **lap, flip turn, relay, and stroke rate.**
